Special Trains to Run on Mysuru-Rameswaram Route

South Western Railway will operate weekly special trains on the Mysuru-Rameswaram route starting October 5 to manage festival season crowds. The service is scheduled to run until a specified end date, with details on timings and stoppages provided.
